purpose: Exploratory registration of a distinct OKX+Binance (USDT) funding-dispersion estimand over the verified historical funding intersection of Binance USD-M futures and OKX USDT-swap perpetuals. This estimand is separately versioned from FVD-DISPERSION-V1, FVD-EXPLORATORY-001, and FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 (Hyperliquid+OKX). It does not modify the frozen grid, FVD001-FVD108, FVD053, or the original run_manifest.json.

estimand.description: Cross-venue funding-dispersion carry hypothesis restricted to the OKX|Binance USD-M pair, both of which settle funding in USDT. Distinct from the original FVD-DISPERSION-V1 estimand (market-cap-weighted universe) and from FVD-EXPLORATORY-002 (Hyperliquid+OKX, settlement unprovable).
estimand.settlement_currency: USDT (provable for both venues: OKX settleCcy=USDT verified via /public/instruments HTTP 200; Binance USD-M settles in USDT by definition + checksum-verified archive provenance)

contract_mapping_basis: underlying symbol match only (e.g. BTCUSDT <-> BTC-USDT-SWAP); instrument metadata cross-check, listing/delisting/lifecycle verification, and historical contract equivalence NOT independently verified via venue metadata or archive provenance
binding_constraint: instrument_identity_not_verified — contract identity between Binance USD-M futures (e.g. BTCUSDT) and OKX USDT-swap perpetuals (e.g. BTC-USDT-SWAP) is symbol-mapped only, not proven equivalent via lifecycle/listing metadata. Per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 3 requirement 1 ('compatible contract identities'), this is not established. This is the binding constraint for this estimand, distinct from the settlement-currency match which IS provable.
anchor_result: NOT EXERCISED — data gate fails before anchor per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 6 stop rule. Instrument identity is not provable (candidate-level, symbol-mapped only) and the OKX+Binance funding intersection is 75 days (< 90-day prior-observation threshold for FVD053). The frozen anchor was not run.

cost_assumptions.note: frozen grid base scenario; sensitivity assumption, not a venue fee claim

sample_construction: Verified historical intersection of instruments with funding settlements + price history on >=2 venues over the OKX+Binance pair; no market-cap rank required for this distinct exploratory estimand; shorter history allowed; not market-cap representative.

coverage_summary.binance_funding_settlements: 2026-08/09/10 overlap months checksum-verified and parsed: 12 funding objects, 1104 funding settlements (276 per symbol, 8h interval) spanning 2026-08-01T00:00:00.001Z to 2026-10-31T16:00:00Z with 0 continuity gaps across month seams; 2026-10 alone was 372 settlements (93 per symbol). Archive depth 2020-01..2026-10 available; 2026-07/earlier months assessed only at CHECKSUM-object availability, not row content.

data_gate_result: NOT_PASSED — settlement currency match is provable for OKX|Binance (both USDT), but contract identity/instrument identity is NOT provable (symbol-mapped only, candidate-level). Per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 3 requirement 1, 'compatible contract identities' are required but not established (Hyperliquid perpetual settlement currency (USDC) is not exposed in the meta endpoint; settlement equivalence is inferred, not proven; OKX baseCcy is empty for linear USDT swaps; no common cross-venue contract identifier or historical listing/delisting timeline is compared). Additionally, the OKX+Binance funding intersection is 75 days (2026-08-17 to 2026-10-31), below the 90-day prior-observation threshold for FVD053. Binance archive provides 6.82+ years of history (meets 3-year depth) and its 2026-10 monthly CHECKSUM objects are now available, but OKX funding retention (277-278 rows, ~92 days, page_not_full) limits the intersection, and the Binance 2026-10 archive content is now checksum-verified and parsed (372 funding rows, 8h interval, last settlement 2026-10-31T16:00Z). No anchor run, no backtest, no performance metric.

exclusion_rules: >=90 prior daily observations required for threshold
compatible contract identities required (NOT met — symbol-mapped only)
implementation_gate_result: Source-independent primitives covered by known-answer/adversarial tests and conformance validators; no real-data anchor run (data gate fails before anchor per exploratory protocol section 6 stop rule)
conclusion: EXPLORATORY_ONLY / INCONCLUSIVE for inference. The OKX+Binance (USDT) estimand registers a distinct exploratory estimand where the settlement-currency sub-component of contract identity IS provable (both venues settle in USDT). However, instrument/contract identity is NOT provable (symbol-mapped only, candidate-level) and the OKX+Binance funding intersection is 75 days (2026-08-17 to 2026-10-31, after OKX's rolling 3-month funding window advanced and the Binance 2026-10 monthly archive object became available), below the 90-day prior-observation threshold for the FVD053 anchor. Because OKX retains only ~3 months of funding while Binance monthly archives publish with a lag, the maximum achievable overlap stays structurally under 90 days. Per exploratory_protocol_v1.md section 6, contract identity is a required eligibility criterion that is not established; the gates fail before anchor. The frozen FVD053 anchor was NOT exercised. No backtest, no performance metric, no economic edge claimed. Confirmatory gate BLOCKED_DATA_GATE preserved.
